text:
sarah_m: Quick thread to assign owners for postmortem follow-ups (quota, scheduler tuning, headroom, canary plan). Short bullets please.

mike_g: I'll run the autoscaler sims (cold KV + burst windows). Plan: baseline vs conservative thresholds. ETA Fri EOD. Will post p99 and cost delta.

anya: I'll update the postmortem doc with recurrence patterns and add the emergency runbook steps (soft-throttle, enable pre-warm pool, notify infra). Draft PR by Wed.

leo_ops: Scheduler items: add inference priorityClass + prefer preempting batch jobs. Also request infra knob: reserved_pool_percent. I'll open PR and infra ticket. ETA next Thu.

olivia_pm: Monitoring: add "scale_failure_rate" metric and pre-alert (failed_alloc >0 for 3m). Block threshold rollout until alerts exist.

dan_s: I'll own the canary rollout and rollback scripts. Canary: 5% traffic, 4h window. Need sims and alerts before canary.

infra-bot: Note: infra maintenance Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC; avoid canary overlap.

mike_g: Simulator command for reproducibility:
```
./sim-replay --trace traces/july-spike-2026.json --burst 6 --cold-cache
```

anya: Short-term mitigation: soft per-tenant burst cap (token bucket) to protect headroom. I'll draft policy and customer-facing wording with @olivia_pm.

sarah_m: Owner summary for ticket: mike_g -> sims (Fri), leo_ops -> scheduler + reserved pool PR (Thu), anya -> runbook + messaging (Wed), dan_s -> canary + rollback (post-sims), olivia_pm -> alerts + thresholds. Reconvene Fri 10:00 to review numbers. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
